name: NocoDB
description: NocoDB is an open-source alternative to Airtable that turns your database into a smart spreadsheet. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys NocoDB as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Turns databases into spreadsheets, an Airtable alternative. Deploy NocoDB with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
